items.source: Note: In case of multiple @Configuration classes, later @Bean definitions will override ones defined in earlier loaded files. This can be leveraged to deliberately override certain bean definitions through an extra Configuration class.
items.translation: 注意：如果有多个 `@Configuration` 类，后来加载的 `@Bean` 定义将覆盖早期文件中定义的 Bean。这可以通过额外的配置类来故意覆盖某些 Bean 定义。

items.source: Create a new AnnotationConfigReactiveWebApplicationContext that needs to be populated through AnnotationConfigApplicationContext.register(Class...) calls and then manually refreshed.
items.translation: 创建一个需要通过 AnnotationConfigApplicationContext.register(Class...) 调用进行填充，然后手动 刷新 的新的 `AnnotationConfigReactiveWebApplicationContext`。

items.source:
Create a new AnnotationConfigApplicationContext, deriving bean definitions from the
given annotated classes and automatically refreshing the context.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 AnnotationConfigApplicationContext，从给定的注解类中派生 Bean 定义并自动刷新上下文。

items.source:
Create a new AnnotationConfigApplicationContext, scanning for bean definitions in
the given packages and automatically refreshing the context.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 AnnotationConfigApplicationContext，扫描给定包中的 Bean 定义并自动刷新上下文。

items.source:
Create a new AnnotationConfigApplicationContext with the given
DefaultListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 使用给定的 DefaultListableBeanFactory 创建一个新的 AnnotationConfigApplicationContext。

items.source: createEnvironment in class AbstractApplicationContext
items.translation: createEnvironment 类中的 AbstractApplicationContext

items.source: annotatedClasses - one or more annotated classes, e.g. @Configuration classes
items.translation: annotatedClasses - 一个或多个已注解的类，例如 @Configuration 类

items.source: getResourceByPath in class DefaultResourceLoader
beanFactory - the DefaultListableBeanFactory instance to use for this context
items.translation: beanFactory - 用于此上下文的 DefaultListableBeanFactory 实例

items.source: basePackages - the packages to check for annotated classes
